stem: Under which pen name did young Rabindranath write "Bhanusingha Thakurer Padabali"?
problem: Answer (Bhanusingha) is the well-known one but no allowed source fetched states that Bhanusingha is a pen name. Banglapedia (Vaisnava Literature) only says Tagore composed Bhanusingha Thakurer Padavali (1884) in Brajabuli. Not linked, not re-asked. Needs a Visva-Bharati / Rabindra Rachanabali page.
quote: rabindranath tagore also composed his Bhanusingha Thakurer Padavali (1884) in this language.

stem: Source disagreement: Premendra Mitra's Sahitya Akademi year
problem: Sahitya Akademi list gives 1957 (Sagar Theke Phera); Banglapedia (Mitra, Premendra) says Akademi prize 1956. The Akademi list is used (GK-WBG-247, GK-WBG-250 only as distractor context). Also Banglapedia dates Alaler Gharer Dulal 1857 (own page) vs 1858 (other pages): no year stated in these facts.

Pen names: Bhanusingha (Tagore), Kamalakanta (Bankim; Banglapedia's only Kamalakanta is a Sakta songwriter, a different person), Jarasandha (Charu Chandra Chakrabarti), Yajabar (Binoy Mukhopadhyay), Abadhut, Nil Lohit as Sunil Gangopadhyay's name (Banglapedia only lists Nila Lohit as Pramatha Chowdhury's story title), Mounomachhi, Bhaskar. Characters: Kiriti Roy, Kakababu, Jayanta-Manik / Bimal-Kumar, Mitin Masi, Debdas as character. Books: Shesher Kabita, Pratham Alo (only a title), Sei Samay Part I. satyajitray.org was not used because it states it is not affiliated with the Ray family or trust (not an institutional source).
